name: smolvla_vision_bundle
_comment: Flow C port of the smolVLA vision encoder at BUNDLE granularity -- 173 tiles, the only decomposition that reaches HTA (50 tiles). Target 2272.3 ms, the best physically-supported configuration; the published 1083.6 ms assumes whole segments run on HTA at the price of their extracted convs, and no ctx_dsp_seg_NN__Hta.bin exists. Contexts live where the smolVLA pipeline staged them, not in the shared ctx dir. Measurements are a separate file so the port cannot perturb the sweep's cost model.
